attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all three of its members and gives each his own couplet, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The corpus keeps very many men called Nicholas on other days, the archbishop of Myra on the day before this one among them; those are other entries on the same calendar and therefore other commemorations, and nothing on this page joins this man to any of them. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
